notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
・Adjusted so that true clear cannot be obtained after returning.
・Fixed some wall omissions

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Typo Corrections
notes.notes:
・Fixed a bug where the EXIT of "Bomberman" and "Underground Health" on Basement Level 1 was connected to Basement Level 1 instead of the ground floor.
・Fixed a bug where the text would loop when using an elixir while already at full health.
・Adjusted so that the dialog does not close when using the dangerous drug.
・Fixed a bug where the skill "Mimic Break" would sometimes not activate.
・Fixed a bug where initiating the skill "Mimic Break" would accidentally start a trade.
・Fixed a bug where defeating a mimic would show an empty item display animation.
・Fixed an issue where having the skill "Lewd Resistance" would prevent lewdness from lewd traps.
・Corrected the following text errors:
"Treasure Chest," "Luxurious Treasure Chest," "Empty Wooden Box"
"Empty Treasure Chest," "Empty Luxurious Treasure Chest"
"Extracted Ore," "Thorn," "Energy Eater"
"Repay Anytime," "Anti-Status"
